name: polish
description: Run a cleanup review, a language pass with the STE100 and Norwegian language skills, and a correctness review on the current branch, round by round, until the project's check passes and a round finds nothing that affects correctness or a stated requirement, or until the round limit (default 3). The run always ends on a correctness review. For a change to a web interface, it first writes behaviour tests when the project has component tests, and ends the report with a click-through when tests cannot show everything or a visual decision is open.
